messages:
Samira: quick synthesis from 4 onboarding sessions today. recurring friction: per-route billing toggle hard to locate, lack of a short cost example, and a few requests for team scoped API keys for staging.
Samira: direct quote: "Spent ten minutes hunting for billing toggle, almost gave up" (BrightLane).
Owen: which accounts and renewal exposure?
Samira: BrightLane (paid, renewal 5w out, flagged), Meridian (pilot, 2 squads), NovaMed (trial, security asked about keys), and PilotPeak (pilot).
Marta: product signal: console discoverability + docs + quick enablement assets. small UX change could be high impact.
Leo: engineering take: surface the toggle on the route list with a small badge and inline tooltip. estimate 0.8 dev days + 0.5 ux. Add a link to a cost-preview page.
Owen: agree prioritize for BrightLane outreach. if we can ship a canary before their renewal call, that helps.
Samira: I'll schedule a 10m walkthrough for BrightLane and prep a short email template.
Marta: also propose a 60s screen recording CSMs can send. I can script it; Leo can record. 48h ETA.
Samira: billing please produce a simple sample table: cost per 10k/100k tokens for typical prompt shapes (chat vs completion). Cc: ops finance.
Leo: team API keys is larger (RBAC/auth)  logging as backlog item under account-security. we'll surface in Q backlog.
Ezra-bot: CS-9009 created: "Onboarding friction: surface per-route billing toggle + cost-preview + enablement video" assigned to Marta, priority P1 for BrightLane follow-up, due 3d.
Marta: picking up CS-9009. I'll post mock and script by EOD tomorrow.
Owen: tagging signals: onboarding-ux, billing-visibility, api-keys-request.
Samira: added a renewal note for BrightLane in tracker: status=at-risk, blocker=console discoverability.
Leo: once billing sheet is in, I'll implement a tiny tooltip linking to it and post screenshots to the ticket.
Samira: thanks everyone. small ops here should move conversion odds. will paste raw transcripts into the ticket if needed. :pray:
